layout.footer: You are receiving this email because you have a Stay.bg account.

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email for Stay.bg
verifyEmail.heading: Hi {name}!
verifyEmail.body: One step left: confirm your email to activate your Stay.bg account.
verifyEmail.ignore: If you did not create an account, you can ignore this email.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your Stay.bg password
resetPassword.heading: Hi {name}!
resetPassword.body: We received a request to reset the password for your account. The link is valid for one hour.
resetPassword.ignore: If you did not ask for a new password, ignore this email — your password stays the same.

viewingAccepted.subject: Viewing confirmed: {listing}
viewingAccepted.heading: Viewing confirmed
viewingAccepted.body: {owner} accepted your request to view “{listing}” on {when}.

viewingDeclined.subject: Viewing request declined: {listing}
viewingDeclined.heading: Request declined
viewingDeclined.body: {owner} cannot host a viewing of “{listing}” on {when}. Browse other listings — new ones appear every day.
